fusions.name: Trampling Run
fusions.desc: Tramples through a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to every enemy in it and knocking them 3 tiles back. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Plough-Ox Kick
fusions.desc: Plants your forefeet and lashes back with both heels, dealing 34 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoulder to the Yoke
fusions.desc: You take 20% less damage for 12 seconds and move 10% faster for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Plodding Reserves
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
